title: P0 lint hole: demo/ modules can import and call the real network api modules (api/vacancy_api, api/auth_api) without tripping the no-network grep
evidence: test.yml lint: `VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rn "rsvp\|api_helpers" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" || true)` and its own error text `demo/ modules must not import the API/network layer`. demo_api.gleam already ships `import api/api_error.{type ApiError}` / `import api/auth_api.{type AuthResponse, AuthResponse}` and passes. auth_api.gleam contains `rsvp.post(` / `rsvp.get(` behind pub fns login/signup/check_session/logout.
detail: The lint greps demo/*.gleam for the literal strings 'rsvp' and 'api_helpers' only. `import api/vacancy_api` + `vacancy_api.list(...)` contains neither string in the demo file, so a real network call from demo code passes the pin the P0 pillar relies on.
recommended_fix: Extend the lint to ban `import api/` in client/src/demo/ except the two type-only imports (api_error, auth_api), e.g. grep for 'import api/' with an explicit allowlist.

title: P0 pillar 2 half-pinned: /demo entry re-seed (enter_demo, init boot + BrowserChangedUrl) has no test — only the Reset button path is covered
evidence: client.gleam: `fn enter_demo(model: Model, route: Route) -> #(Model, Effect(Msg)) {` / `case demo_store.seed() {` with the Error branch falling back to `routes.Landing, demo_mode: False`. Tests: demo_flow_test builds state manually (`fn demo_model() -> model.Model { ... model.Model(..model.initial(), route: routes.Demo, demo_mode: True, ...)`) and the only wipe test is `pub fn demo_reset_wipes_state_test()` driving `msg.UserClickedResetDemo`. No test references enter_demo or BrowserChangedUrl(routes.Demo).
detail: Refresh/deep-link re-entry re-seeds exclusively through enter_demo (request-id seeding for stale-response guards, deep-link effects, seed-failure fallback). A regression keeping a stale store across /demo entry fails no test, weakening the proven-non-persistence pillar.
recommended_fix: Add a test driving client.update with BrowserChangedUrl(/demo and a v- deep link) over a mutated demo_store, asserting a fresh seed, request ids set, and the Error branch landing fallback.

title: P1 dispatch-arm coverage <80%: ~23 of ~30 demo_update.handle branches have no update-path test, and no error path (deliver_err / map_pdf_result) is tested anywhere
evidence: demo_flow_test.pub fns: demo_entry_shows_dashboard_test, demo_dashboard_resolves_test, demo_vacancy_detail_and_leaderboard_resolve_test, demo_application_detail_resolves_test, demo_reset_wipes_state_test, demo_exit_clears_demo_state_test, demo_requests_are_intercepted_test (7 tests). Untested arms include `UserConfirmedApproval(vid, aid) -> {` (batches a leaderboard refetch), `UserClickedPublishVacancy(id)`, `UserConfirmedCloseVacancy(id)`, `UserConfirmedArchiveVacancy(id)`, `UserChoseRefcheckAction`, `UserClickedDownloadReport(id)`, `AppRequestedScoringStatus(generation, vid, _visible)` generation guard, plus demo_api's `deliver_err`/`internal_error` and `map_pdf_result` non-2xx/0-byte/fetch-error branches.
detail: Store mutations are tested only at store level; the wiring layer (loading flags, store threading, effect.batch, stale-store refetch in UserConfirmedApproval) and every synthetic-error branch have zero coverage, so dispatch regressions fail no test.
recommended_fix: Add update-path tests for the mutation arms (status/approve/reject, publish/close/archive, refcheck, download guard) and a deliver_err test feeding an unknown vacancy/application id asserting the Error response.

title: Fetch exemption in the no-network lint is file-wide: any URL fetch added anywhere in demo_api.gleam passes CI
evidence: `FETCH_VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rln "gleam/fetch" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" | grep -v "demo_api.gleam" || true)`. demo_api.gleam currently has the single permitted call: `let url = "/static/demo/report-" <> application_id <> ".pdf"` and `use fetch_result <- promise.try_await(fetch.send(req))`.
detail: The lint exempts the whole 588-line demo_api.gleam from the fetch ban, so the 'only the pre-baked static PDF fetch' contract is pinned by review, not by the lint. A second fetch to a real endpoint inside demo_api would go green.
recommended_fix: Pin the exemption tighter: grep demo_api.gleam for fetch.send occurrences and fail if more than one, or extract the PDF fetch into a tiny demo_download.gleam and exempt only that file.

title: Claimed browser-E2E coverage of demo effect execution does not exist — no bug-hunt scenario covers /demo, so the real request→response bridge and the PDF fetch run in no automated test
evidence: demo_flow_test header: `Because Lustre effects are opaque to Node tests, the request→response bridge is exercised in two steps ... The browser E2E (bug-hunt) covers the effect execution.` But `.pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/` contains no demo scenario (only unrelated `workflows/seed-archetype-applicants.yaml` / `seed-applicants.yaml` mentioning 'demo vacancy').
detail: The flow test feeds response messages manually; the actual effect dispatch, the one real network touch (static PDF fetch + 90s timeout), and banner/CTA chrome execute only in a browser. The cited E2E layer is aspirational — coverage is unit-only.
recommended_fix: Add a bug-hunt YAML scenario for /demo (entry → dashboard → detail → download report → reset), or correct the test comment and PR checklist to say browser verification was manual.

title: Round-trip drift guard covers only ApplicationDetail — PR body's 'round-trips of derived surfaces' (plural) overstates the pin
evidence: PR body: `plus encode→decode round-trips of derived surfaces. A drifted API shape fails the build.` The only round-trip in the suite is in demo_store_application_detail_round_trip_test: `detail |> application_detail.encode |> json.to_string` then `json.parse(json_str, application_detail.decoder())`. VacancyDetail, LeaderboardResponse and VacancyWithStats derivations are asserted by value only.
detail: Typed construction catches field drift at compile time, so the residual risk is small, but codec-level drift on the other derived surfaces would not fail make test despite the PR body's plural claim.
recommended_fix: Either round-trip leaderboard/vacancy_detail through their shared codecs in the conformance suite, or amend the PR body to say the round-trip covers ApplicationDetail only.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence: P0 pillars: (1) no-network pin PARTIAL — lint exists but is bypassable via `import api/*` and the file-wide demo_api fetch exemption (test.yml:132-136); (2) refresh/reset wipe PARTIAL — demo_reset_wipes_state_test covers Reset only, enter_demo untested (client.gleam:5698); (3) fixture decode FULL — fixtures_conformance_test decodes all 4 fixture groups via production shared/ decoders plus an ApplicationDetail encode→decode round-trip; (4) live-path inert FULL — diff.patch touches no client/src/api/* file and demo_requests_are_intercepted_test pins interception.
detail: P0 = 2/4 pillars fully pinned (<100% → FAIL). P1 dispatch-arm coverage ~25% (7 of ~30 demo_update branches through the update path; zero error-path tests) — well under 80%. Overall behaviour-surface coverage ~50-60%, under 80%. E2E layer claimed but absent.
recommended_fix: Close the lint's api-import bypass, add enter_demo/BrowserChangedUrl re-seed tests, add update-path tests for the mutation arms plus deliver_err coverage, and commit a bug-hunt /demo scenario — that lifts P0 to 100% and P1 above 90%.
